start.text: Report sent. A crowd of customers and a flood look alike from far away. One of them buys things.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Joshua, I read your report. Do not count the crowd tonight. Look at what each visitor does.
A.name: Carla

B.text: A real customer looks around the shop, in a real browser, a few times a minute.
B.name: Carla

C1.text: The [b][color=green]rulebook[/color][/b] has the signs: how many requests from one address, how many pages, and what the browser calls itself. A big number alone decides nothing.
C1.name: Carla

C2.text: No. The sale is busy and real. We would turn away the people we want. We block the behavior, not the hour.
C2.name: Carla

D.text: [b][color=red]Report[/color][/b] traffic that breaks a rule. Let the rest [b][color=green]pass[/color][/b], even a huge crowd.
D.name: Carla

E.text: One minute of traffic at a time. Big is not bad, and quiet is not safe.
E.name: Joshua
